description: This file contains tests for the functions 'noteGroupMember' and 'formatGroupMembers', which are related to managing and formatting group member information in a WhatsApp extension. It uses the Vitest testing framework to validate behavior such as phone number normalization, deduplication, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: noteGroupMember
methods.description: Adds or updates a group member in the member map, normalizing phone numbers and handling incomplete data.

methods.name: formatGroupMembers
methods.description: Formats a list of group participants and roster members into a string, deduplicating and including named roster members.

ctags.name: groupMemberNames
ctags.pattern: /^    const groupMemberNames = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();$/
